people.name: Crawford F. Sams
people.role: Brigadier General, Chief, Public Health and Welfare Section, SCAP

section_summary: This section holds the Japan (SCAP Public Health and Welfare Section) annual narcotics statistical returns for 1948 and estimates for 1949, signed 22 March 1949 by Brig. Gen. Crawford F. Sams, for the Permanent Central Opium Board. It covers Forms A(L), B(L), C(1), C(2), C(3), D and the confiscations form, with remarks and reconciliations. It ends with State Department transmittal and routing papers (April-September 1949) and the opening pages of the UN publication of Japan's 1948 annual report.

subfiles.about: Annual statistics of imports and exports of codeine and dionine, showing a codeine import from the U.S.A.
subfiles.from: SCAP Public Health and Welfare Section (Brig. Gen. Crawford F. Sams)
subfiles.summary: Form shows 303.8 kg codeine imported from U.S.A. (final balance of requisitioned shipment, 434 kg phosphate); exports nil.
subfiles.title: Statistical Form A(L): Imports and Exports of Methylmorphine and Ethylmorphine

subfiles.about: Estimates for 1949 of drug amounts to bring stocks to desired levels, with calculation notes.
subfiles.from: SCAP Public Health and Welfare Section (Brig. Gen. Crawford F. Sams)
subfiles.summary: Sets out 1949 consumption, stock and manufacture figures for morphine, cocaine, eucodal, thebaine, codeine and dionine. The form asks the Board to advise if the method is incorrect. Explanatory notes follow.
subfiles.title: Form B(L) Part 2: Stock Estimates, with calculation sheets

subfiles.about: Annual estimates of consumption, conversion and stock levels for 1949, with an amended statement of method.
subfiles.from: SCAP Public Health and Welfare Section (Brig. Gen. Crawford F. Sams)
subfiles.summary: Estimates for 1949 for morphine, cocaine, eucodal, thebaine, codeine and dionine, with a statement of how they were calculated from 1948 consumption and stocks. Some morphine and cocaine stocks need repurification.
subfiles.title: Form B(L) Part 1: Annual Estimates of Drugs 1949, with Statement of Method

subfiles.about: Japan's 1948 consumption of opium, coca leaves and drugs.
subfiles.from: SCAP Public Health and Welfare Section (Brig. Gen. Crawford F. Sams)
subfiles.summary: Reports medicinal opium 57.960 kg, opium preparations 186.298 kg, morphine 258.964 kg, cocaine 163.684 kg and eucodal 3.218 kg consumed. Remarks add codeine, dionine, dihydrocodeine and demerol. Notes and equivalence tables.
subfiles.title: Form C(1)(GL): Annual Statistics of Consumption 1948

subfiles.about: 1948 quantities received in factories and manufactured or disposed of, by drug.
subfiles.from: SCAP Public Health and Welfare Section (Brig. Gen. Crawford F. Sams)
subfiles.summary: Raw opium received in factories 53,020.759 kg and coca leaves 18,627.370 kg. It gives manufacture figures for morphine, codeine, cocaine, ecgonine, eucodal and thebaine. Remarks correct 1947 errors, including powdered opium misreported as morphine, and reconcile morphine quantities.
subfiles.title: Form C(2)(GL): Annual Statistics of Production and Manufacture 1948

subfiles.about: Prepared opium return, noted as not applicable to Japan.
subfiles.from: SCAP Public Health and Welfare Section (Brig. Gen. Crawford F. Sams)
subfiles.summary: All entries nil; prepared opium import, possession, manufacture, sale and use are prohibited in Japan.
subfiles.title: Form C(3)(G): Annual Statistics of Prepared Opium

subfiles.about: Stocks of opium and drugs held at the end of 1948, with reconciliations to the 1947 report.
subfiles.from: SCAP Public Health and Welfare Section (Brig. Gen. Crawford F. Sams)
subfiles.summary: Lists wholesaler, manufacturer and Government stocks, including 27,604.704 kg raw opium received from Korea in 1948 as a security measure. Remarks balance each drug against 1947 figures, noting losses, thefts, salvage by the Drug Disposal Committee, and adulterated former Japanese army stocks to be repurified. Also covers crude cocaine held under SCAP supervision.
subfiles.title: Form D(GL): Annual Statistics of Stocks at 31 December 1948, with remarks

subfiles.from: SCAP Public Health and Welfare Section (Brig. Gen. Crawford F. Sams)
subfiles.summary: Nearly all entries nil. Remarks report 600.886 g alkaloid content of 900.88 g crude morphine smuggled from Korea, seized at a clandestine heroin laboratory in Osaka run by a Korean. Small amounts also seized from repatriates.
subfiles.title: Form E: Annual Statistics of Confiscations 1948

subfiles.about: Transmits SCAP-prepared statistical forms on behalf of Japan.
subfiles.summary: Lists the Forms A to E for 1948-1949 enclosed.
subfiles.title: State Department transmittal of statistical forms to Permanent Central Opium Board
subfiles.to: President of the Permanent Central Opium Board

subfiles.about: Sends copy of SCAP telegram C 50414 of 31 May 1949 reporting on narcotics.
subfiles.summary: Confidential covering letter for information; enclosure is SCAP telegram to Department of the Army.
subfiles.title: Transmittal of telegram C 50414 to Treasury Bureau of Narcotics
subfiles.to: Secretary of the Treasury (Bureau of Narcotics)

subfiles.about: Acknowledge instructions and confirm enclosures sent to the Acting Secretary-General of the UN.
subfiles.from: United States Representative at the Seat of the United Nations
subfiles.summary: Three near-identical notes (Nos. 3062, 3063, 3064) confirming forwarding of enclosures to the UN Acting Secretary-General.
subfiles.title: US Mission to UN acknowledgments of Department instructions

subfiles.about: Cover and note communicating Japan's 1948 annual narcotics report, via the United States.
subfiles.summary: Cover with distribution routing slip (Sept. 1949), document E/NR.1948/58 of 15 August 1949, and Secretary-General's note citing Article 21 of the 1931 Convention. Page 255 is blank.
subfiles.title: UN publication: Annual Report of Japan for 1948 and Secretary-General's note
subfiles.to: Members of the United Nations and parties to the Convention
